title.purpose: Card titles, task titles, command task headings.

body.purpose: Agent lead copy, panel descriptions. Max 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Overlines, nav section headers, status tags. Uppercase, wide tracking.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Structural panels, chat containers, command panels.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Highest-priority panels only — greeting strips, detail headers.

shadows.name: inset-accent

shadows.name: inset-accent-soft

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Constructive actions: create agent, send message, assign, approve.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; background: #9a6cff; color: #f8f7ff; border: 1px solid #9a6cff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Segoe UI, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(3,8,18,0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(154,108,255,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #f8f7ff; border: 1px solid rgba(156,111,251,0.62); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Segoe UI, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(3,8,18,0.22); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(154,108,255,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Language switcher, persona toggles, filter tabs.
components.css: .ds-pill-wrap { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-pill { padding: 8px 11px; color: #f8f7ff; background: rgba(153,112,244,0.16); border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(153,112,244,0.28); font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-pill:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(3,8,18,0.22); } .ds-pill-active { background: #9a6cff; border-color: #9a6cff; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(154,108,255,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation button — resting and active states.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 7px; } .ds-nav-btn { min-height: 42px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; color: #eef2ff; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; text-align: left; font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-btn:hover, .ds-nav-active { border-color: rgba(156,111,251,0.62); background: rgba(154,108,255,0.14); } .ds-nav-btn:hover { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-nav-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; background: #9a6cff; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(154,108,255,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Agent Chat Bubble
components.description: Agent and user message bubbles in the workspace chat.
components.html:
The CPMOO agent has reviewed the portfolio and flagged three work packages for approval.
Approve all three and generate a status brief.
components.css: .ds-messages { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 18px; } .ds-msg { max-width: min(680px, 90%); padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 8px; line-height: 1.45; font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(153,112,244,0.28); color: #eef2ff; } .ds-msg-agent { align-self: flex-start; background: rgba(12,18,27,0.5); box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 rgba(154,108,255,0.48); } .ds-msg-user { align-self: flex-end; background: rgba(154,108,255,0.2); border-color: rgba(156,111,251,0.62); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Inline agent or task status indicator. Always includes a colored dot.
components.html: LivePendingDone
components.css: .ds-status-wrap { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #eef2ff; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #74819b; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-live::before { background: #5ce2a6; } .ds-status-pending::before { background: #8e63f3; } .ds-status-done::before { background: #63bb5b; }

components.name: Data Surface Card
components.description: Flat data container for metrics, KPI rows, task items. No shadow. Recedes behind panels.
components.html: Active Agents123 awaiting approval
components.css: .ds-data-card { min-height: 104px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(153,112,244,0.28); background: rgba(12,18,27,0.34); border-radius: 8px; display: grid; align-content: space-between; gap: 12px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-data-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 14px; top: 14px; width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid rgba(154,108,255,0.2); border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .ds-data-label, .ds-data-meta { color: #a9b7ce; font-size: 13px; font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-data-num { color: #f8f7ff; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Segoe UI, sans-serif; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Primary Agent Node
components.description: Org chart node for a primary (CPMOO-level) agent. Carries the violet inset bar.
components.html: Executive TierCPMOO AgentPortfolio command center
components.css: .ds-agent-node { width: 200px; min-height: 110px; padding: 14px; background: rgba(12,18,27,0.42); border: 1px solid rgba(153,112,244,0.28); border-radius: 8px; display: grid; gap: 8px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-agent-node::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 12px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgba(154,108,255,0.22); border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .ds-agent-primary { border-color: #9a6cff; background: rgba(154,108,255,0.14); box-shadow: inset 5px 0 0 #7356f0; } .ds-tier-label { color: #d7ccff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-agent-node strong { color: #ffffff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; } .ds-agent-role { color: #a9b7ce; font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
NawaahOS is not a tool users operate — it is an operating model they inhabit. The interface behaves like a well-run executive floor: quiet, purposeful, nothing explained that doesn't need explaining. Every screen is organized around one agent, one context, one conversation. The surface recedes so the work can come forward.

The palette is deep navy-indigo with a single violet accent. The violet never shouts; it marks focus, ownership, and state. Typography is heavy and authoritative at large sizes, clean and neutral at body size — the kind of type that implies the system already knows what it's doing. Spacing is generous, breathing room is intentional. No grid of identical cards, no fields with labels above every one, no dashboard that tries to show everything at once.

This system explicitly rejects the enterprise software aesthetic: SAP's dense form grids, Salesforce's candy-colored status noise, Monday.com's card explosion, ServiceNow's everything-visible-at-once philosophy. It also rejects the SaaS-startup reflex: gradient hero metrics, glassmorphism containers, icon+heading+explainer card grids, modal-first interactions.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy-indigo dark mode; no light-mode equivalent
Single violet accent, used structurally (borders, state indicators, inset marks), never decoratively
Heavy display weight (800) at large sizes; neutral weight at body
Agent chat as primary surface; dashboards and data are secondary
Inset accent bars (4–5px start-aligned) as the signature structural marker
Ghost circles as spatial texture (not functional affordances)

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Violet appears on ≤15% of any given surface. Its presence signals something specific — an agent is active, this item requires attention, this card is primary. Spreading it across backgrounds or decorative borders destroys the signal.

rules.name: The One Dark Rule
rules.body: There is no light mode. The interface is designed for a desktop operator in a working environment. Do not introduce light surface variants.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every adjacent pair of text elements must differ by at least 300 in font-weight or ≥1.25× in font-size. Flat hierarchies read as noise.

rules.name: The Inset Bar Rule
rules.body: The violet inset bar (box-shadow: inset 4–5px 0 0 #7356f0) is a structural semantic: it means this element has ownership, elevated state, or is the primary agent surface. It is not a decorative stripe. Do not apply it to non-semantic cards, list items, or background containers.

dos: Do use the inset violet bar only on elements that carry ownership, elevation, or agent-primary state.
Do mirror the inset bar to the end edge on RTL.
Do keep the violet accent to ≤15% of any screen surface.
Do use translateY(-1px) + ambient shadow as the sole hover treatment for interactive cards and buttons.
Do use the pill shape for filter controls, language switches, and persona toggles — never for primary actions.
Do use label typography only for structural labeling: overlines, section headers, tier labels, status text.
Do include the status dot alongside any status text. Color alone is not sufficient.
Do structure new pages with one primary agent surface as the focal point.
donts: Don't use SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or Oracle-style dense layouts.
Don't build Monday.com or Jira-style identical card grids.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default surface treatment.
Don't use the hero-metric template: big number, small label, gradient accent, repeated in a row.
Don't use modals as the first-response to any action.
Don't add border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe for decoration.
Don't spread the ghost circle texture to interactive components.
Don't use the violet accent as a large area fill.
